body:
#### PR description:

This PR is part of the series of backports of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911 following the request in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/47050#issuecomment-6069544996. In contrast to the earlier series of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52369 and its forward-ports, this PR takes a different approach because 16_0_X already includes the `FWStorage` package (https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49594), and the xrootd packet labeling (https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49879, https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51244). Therefore it seemed easier to backport the PRs that would allow #50911 to apply (rather) cleanly. This PR thus includes
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50419 (compare to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/compare/682292193edae27dcd15314f12035dc166e85eb4...81294360d14d5c017e1805e3cf06863edba6bae6)
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50390 (compare to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/compare/81294360d14d5c017e1805e3cf06863edba6bae6...cbe6ef7fccc3473d446333ebea64212908a0e381)
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50486 (compare to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/compare/cbe6ef7fccc3473d446333ebea64212908a0e381...ae300e77b9c31ff15cb56cc1039f361f3a598859)

in addition to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911 (compare to ccee063f7429)

Code compiles
